senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. preced. wds. a. to be strong, hard, old (cmp. קשיש).—V. יוֹשֶׁן a. next w.

units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 91b:16">B. Bath. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>דברים שדרכן ליַישְּׁנָן</he> things which it is customary to keep (to store, as wine &c.).
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 9:1">Deut. R. s. 9</cite>, beg. <he>מן היין הזה אני מְיַישֵּׁן וכ׳</he> of this wine I will store away a portion for my son’s wedding.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:3">Tosef. Ab. Zar. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 9:3">IX</cite>), 3 <he>צריך ליַשֵּׁן</he> he must store them away (leave them unused); <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 11:16">Tosef. Toh. XI, 16</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 11:16">Ib.</cite> <he>כמה הוא מְיַשְּׁנָן</he>, v. <cite ref="J00683"><he>יִשּׁוּן</he></cite>; Y. Ab. Zar. V, end 45ᵇ <he>מְיַישְּׁנָן כל י״ב וכ׳</he> he must leave them unused for the whole twelve-month; Bab.
Ab. Zar. 75ᵃ.—Part. pass. מְיוּשָּׁן stored up, v. infra. Y. B. Bath. VII, end, 15ᶜ. Y. Gitt. III, end, 45ᵇ ‘old’ means last year’s crop, מי׳ של וכ׳ ‘stored’ means three years old.

senses.gloss: to be stored up, to improve with age. Sifra B’huck. ch. III; Yalk. Lev. 672 (ref. to ישן נושן, Lev. XXVI, 10) כל המִתְיַשֵּׁן יפה מחבירו the sort which is stored up is the better of its kind; B. Bath. l. c. [read with Ms. R.:] כל המְיוּשָּׁן יפה מחבירו. Y. Gitt. l. c. הדא אמרה דאי מתישן וכ׳ this intimates that if wine is sold as mithyashshen (fit for storage) the seller is responsible for three years. Sifra l. c. לרבות כל המִתְיַישְּׁנִים including all produces fit for storage (besides wine); Yalk. l. c. לרבות כל הדבר המיושן.
<cite ref="J00697">same</cite>. B. Bath. l. c.; a e., v. <cite ref="J00699">next w.</cite>
